title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The rollout details, administrator installation requirement and documented control calls are supported. The licensing field incorrectly treats unpublished A2A-specific charges as unpublished entitlement, although Microsoft documents the underlying Copilot agent access models. The authentication description also needs to acknowledge conflicting property names in Microsoft's guides.

claims.quote: If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.
